쿼리 작성: SELECT
  g.geolocation_state,
  g.geolocation_city,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS total_customers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                   WHEN LOWER(c.customer_city) = LOWER(g.geolocation_city) THEN c.customer_id

쿼리 작성: WITH customers_by_geo_state AS (

ranked AS (

)

쿼리 작성: WITH cust_geo_states AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id, i.geolocation_state
  FROM customers c
  JOIN geolocation i
    ON i.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = c.customer_zip_code_prefix
),
per_uid AS (
  SELECT customer_unique_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT geolocation_state) AS state_cnt,
         MIN(geolocation_state) AS only_state
  FROM cust_geo_states
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
),
denom AS (
  SELECT i.geolocation_state AS geo_state,
         COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS customers_including
  FROM customers c
  JOIN geolocation i
    ON i.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = c.customer_zip_code_prefix
  GROUP BY i.geolocation_state
),
numer AS (
  SELECT only_state AS geo_state,
         COUNT(*) AS customers_exclusive
  FROM per_uid
  WHERE state_cnt = 1
  GROUP BY only_state
)
SELECT d.geo_state,
       COALESCE(n.customers_exclusive, 0) AS customers_exclusive,
       d.customers_including,
       COALESCE(n.customers_exclusive, 0) * 1.0 / d.customers_including AS exclusive_ratio
FROM denom d
LEFT JOIN numer n
  ON n.geo_state = d.geo_state
ORDER BY exclusive_ratio DESC, d.geo_state;

),
city_zips AS (

SELECT cz.customer_city,

쿼리 작성: WITH base AS (

totals AS (

),
ranked AS (

쿼리 작성: WITH per_customer AS (

         MAX(CASE
               WHEN LOWER(SUBSTR(i.geolocation_city, 1, 3)) = LOWER(SUBSTR(c.customer_city, 1, 3))
               THEN 1 ELSE 0
             END) AS has_prefix_match
  FROM customers c

    ON i.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = c.customer_zip_code_prefix
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_state

SELECT customer_state,

쿼리 작성: WITH uid_geo AS (

),
uid_geo_ranked AS (

uid_cust AS (

uid_cust_ranked AS (

SELECT g.customer_unique_id,

       g.cnt AS geo_count,

       cc.customer_state AS top_customer_state,

  ON cc.customer_unique_id = g.customer_unique_id

  AND cc.rn = 1
LIMIT 100;

쿼리 작성: WITH city_state_diversity AS (
  SELECT i.geolocation_state,
         i.geolocation_city,
         COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_state) AS customer_states
  FROM customers c
  JOIN geolocation i
    ON i.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = c.customer_zip_code_prefix
  GROUP BY i.geolocation_state, i.geolocation_city
)
SELECT geolocation_state,
       COUNT(*) AS geo_cities_with_3plus_customer_states
FROM city_state_diversity
WHERE customer_states >= 3
GROUP BY geolocation_state
ORDER BY geo_cities_with_3plus_customer_states DESC, geolocation_state;

쿼리 작성: WITH zip_coord_cnt AS (
  SELECT geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip, COUNT(*) AS coord_cnt
  FROM geolocation
  GROUP BY geolocation_zip_code_prefix
),
state_zips AS (
  SELECT customer_state, customer_zip_code_prefix AS zip
  FROM customers
  GROUP BY customer_state, customer_zip_code_prefix
)
SELECT sz.customer_state,
       COUNT(*) AS distinct_zip_count,
       AVG(zc.coord_cnt) AS avg_coords_per_zip
FROM state_zips sz
JOIN zip_coord_cnt zc ON zc.zip = sz.zip
GROUP BY sz.customer_state
ORDER BY sz.customer_state

쿼리 작성: SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT g.geolocation_city) AS distinct_geo_cities
FROM customers c
JOIN geolocation g
  ON g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = c.customer_zip_code_prefix
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY distinct_geo_cities DESC, c.customer_unique_id
LIMIT 10

쿼리 작성: SELECT g.geolocation_state,
       MAX(g.geolocation_lng) - MIN(g.geolocation_lng) AS lng_range,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers
FROM geolocation g
JOIN customers c
  ON c.customer_zip_code_prefix = g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
GROUP BY g.geolocation_state
ORDER BY g.geolocation_state

쿼리 작성: SELECT c.customer_state,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS mismatched_city_customers
FROM customers c
JOIN geolocation g
  ON g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = c.customer_zip_code_prefix
WHERE c.customer_state = g.geolocation_state
  AND LOWER(TRIM(c.customer_city)) <> LOWER(TRIM(g.geolocation_city))
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY mismatched_city_customers DESC, c.customer_state

쿼리 작성: WITH city_counts AS (
  SELECT c.customer_state,
         g.geolocation_city,
         COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count
  FROM customers c
  JOIN geolocation g
    ON g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = c.customer_zip_code_prefix
  GROUP BY c.customer_state, g.geolocation_city
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT customer_state, geolocation_city, customer_count,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_state ORDER BY customer_count DESC, geolocation_city) AS rn
  FROM city_counts
)
SELECT customer_state, geolocation_city, customer_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY customer_state, customer_count DESC, geolocation_city

쿼리 작성: SELECT g.geolocation_city,
       g.geolocation_state,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_state) AS customer_state_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM geolocation g
JOIN customers c
  ON c.customer_zip_code_prefix = g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
GROUP BY g.geolocation_city, g.geolocation_state
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_state) >= 5
ORDER BY customer_state_count DESC, customer_count DESC, g.geolocation_city

쿼리 작성: WITH multi_city_zips AS (
  SELECT geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip
  FROM geolocation
  GROUP BY geolocation_zip_code_prefix
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT geolocation_city) > 1
),
customer_zips AS (
  SELECT customer_unique_id, customer_zip_code_prefix AS zip
  FROM customers
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id, customer_zip_code_prefix
),
eligible_customers AS (
  SELECT cz.customer_unique_id
  FROM customer_zips cz
  LEFT JOIN multi_city_zips mcz ON mcz.zip = cz.zip
  GROUP BY cz.customer_unique_id
  HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN mcz.zip IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) = 0
)
SELECT ec.customer_unique_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cz.zip) AS distinct_zip_count
FROM eligible_customers ec
JOIN customer_zips cz
  ON cz.customer_unique_id = ec.customer_unique_id
GROUP BY ec.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY distinct_zip_count DESC, ec.customer_unique_id

쿼리 작성: WITH sp_zips AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip
  FROM geolocation
  WHERE geolocation_state = 'SP'
)
SELECT c.customer_city,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_zip_code_prefix) AS sp_zip_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM customers c
JOIN sp_zips sz
  ON sz.zip = c.customer_zip_code_prefix
GROUP BY c.customer_city
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_zip_code_prefix) >= 3
ORDER BY sp_zip_count DESC, customer_count DESC, c.customer_city

쿼리 작성: WITH pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT g.geolocation_city,
                  g.geolocation_state,
                  c.customer_id,
                  c.customer_city
  FROM geolocation g
  JOIN customers c
    ON c.customer_zip_code_prefix = g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
),
agg AS (
  SELECT geolocation_city,
         geolocation_state,
         COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
         SUM(CASE
               WHEN UPPER(SUBSTRING(customer_city, 1, 2)) = UPPER(SUBSTRING(geolocation_city, 1, 2))
               THEN 1 ELSE 0
             END) AS match_count
  FROM pairs
  GROUP BY geolocation_city, geolocation_state
)
SELECT geolocation_city,
       geolocation_state,
       total_customers,
       100.0 * match_count / total_customers AS match_ratio_pct
FROM agg
ORDER BY match_ratio_pct DESC, total_customers DESC, geolocation_city

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  c.customer_state,
  MIN(g.geolocation_lat) AS min_lat,
  MAX(g.geolocation_lat) AS max_lat,
  MIN(g.geolocation_lng) AS min_lng,
  MAX(g.geolocation_lng) AS max_lng
FROM customers c
JOIN geolocation g
  ON g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = c.customer_zip_code_prefix
GROUP BY c.customer_state

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  g.geolocation_city,
  g.geolocation_state,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_city) AS distinct_customer_city_count,
  AVG(DISTINCT g.geolocation_lat) AS avg_lat
FROM customers c
JOIN geolocation g
  ON g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = c.customer_zip_code_prefix
GROUP BY g.geolocation_city, g.geolocation_state
ORDER BY distinct_customer_city_count DESC, g.geolocation_city;

쿼리 작성: WITH per_customer AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_state,
    MAX(CASE WHEN g.geolocation_state <> c.customer_state THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_mismatch
  FROM customers c
  JOIN geolocation g
    ON g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = c.customer_zip_code_prefix
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_state
)
SELECT
  customer_state,
  SUM(is_mismatch) AS mismatched_customer_count,
  COUNT(*) AS total_customer_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(is_mismatch) / COUNT(*), 2) AS mismatch_rate_pct
FROM per_customer
GROUP BY customer_state
ORDER BY mismatch_rate_pct DESC, customer_state;

쿼리 작성: WITH coords_per_zip AS (
  SELECT
    g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip,
    COUNT(*) AS coord_count
  FROM geolocation g
  GROUP BY g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix
),
customers_per_zip AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_zip_code_prefix AS zip,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count
  FROM customers c
  GROUP BY c.customer_zip_code_prefix
),
rep_state AS (
  SELECT
    g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip,
    g.geolocation_state,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, g.geolocation_state) AS rn
  FROM geolocation g
  GROUP BY g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix, g.geolocation_state
)
SELECT
  cz.zip AS customer_zip_code_prefix,
  cz.customer_count,
  co.coord_count,
  rs.geolocation_state AS representative_geolocation_state
FROM customers_per_zip cz
JOIN coords_per_zip co
  ON co.zip = cz.zip
JOIN rep_state rs
  ON rs.zip = cz.zip AND rs.rn = 1
ORDER BY cz.customer_count DESC, cz.zip;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  c.customer_city,
  COUNT(DISTINCT g.geolocation_state) AS geolocation_state_count,
  AVG(g.geolocation_lng) AS avg_lng
FROM customers c
JOIN geolocation g
  ON g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = c.customer_zip_code_prefix

쿼리 작성: WITH city_match AS (
  SELECT
    g.geolocation_state AS geo_state,
    g.geolocation_city AS geo_city,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS total_customers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.customer_state = g.geolocation_state THEN c.customer_id END) AS matched_customers
  FROM customers c
  JOIN geolocation g
    ON g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = c.customer_zip_code_prefix
  GROUP BY g.geolocation_state, g.geolocation_city
)
SELECT
  geo_state,
  COUNT(*) AS city_count_with_match_rate_ge_80pct
FROM city_match
WHERE total_customers > 0
  AND matched_customers >= 0.8 * total_customers
GROUP BY geo_state
ORDER BY city_count_with_match_rate_ge_80pct DESC, geo_state;

쿼리 작성: WITH city_state_lat AS (

    g.geolocation_state,
    AVG(ABS(g.geolocation_lat)) AS avg_abs_lat
  FROM customers c
  JOIN geolocation g
    ON g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = c.customer_zip_code_prefix
  GROUP BY c.customer_city, g.geolocation_state
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    customer_city,
    geolocation_state,
    avg_abs_lat,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_city ORDER BY avg_abs_lat DESC, geolocation_state) AS rn
  FROM city_state_lat
)
SELECT
  customer_city,
  geolocation_state,
  avg_abs_lat
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY avg_abs_lat DESC, customer_city;

쿼리 작성: SELECT

  c.customer_state,

FROM customers c
